title: start-record-detached.ps1 is not detached from its CALLER: Start-Process -RedirectStandardOutput/-RedirectStandardError forces UseShellExecute=false, so the child inherits the caller's stdio handles and any pipe-reading caller blocks for the recording's entire lifetime.
evidence: Measured 2026-09-27 with a minimal repro (8s child): WITH redirects 10.2s wall for the launching powershell pipeline, WITHOUT redirects 2.3s. Reproduced through the real launcher: printed 'started detached record: pid 41852' immediately but the bash pipeline did not return for 32.7s (the fixture's own lifetime). PRE-EXISTING, not introduced by the ISS-323 fix: the pnpm version carried the identical redirects.
fix_direction: Not blocking U5: task-scheduler.ts launches via a one-off Windows Scheduled Task, which reads no pipe (its only symptom there is a task row that shows 'running' for the webinar's duration). Affects programmatic/CLI callers that capture output. A fix must not trade away the ISS-323 liveness gate, which REQUIRES waiting on the child: a two-stage launch (outer Start-Process with no redirects, inner stage doing the redirected launch) detaches cleanly but cannot report the real pid or the liveness verdict back to the caller. Needs a design call before building.
